WITH recent_moves AS (
    -- Scope the stock_moves rows
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,
        moved_at,
        operator,
        unit_price,
        LEAST(qty, unit_price) AS least_qty_unit_price
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE unit_price < 290.4
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous moved_at per operator
    SELECT *, LAG(moved_at) OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY moved_at, id) AS prev_moved_at
    FROM recent_moves
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_moved_at IS NULL OR moved_at > prev_moved_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY moved_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        operator,
        session_id,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(moved_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY operator, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    operator,
    session_id,
    n_events,
    duration_min
FROM sessions
WHERE n_events < 5
ORDER BY operator DESC, duration_min, session_id
LIMIT 5

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_moves = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("unit_price") < 290.4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
        F.least(F.col("qty"), F.col("unit_price")).alias("least_qty_unit_price"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent_moves.withColumn("prev_moved_at", F.lag("moved_at").over(Window.partitionBy("operator").orderBy("moved_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_moved_at").isNull() | (F.col("moved_at") > F.col("prev_moved_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("operator").orderBy("moved_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("operator", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("moved_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("moved_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("moved_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("moved_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .filter(F.col("n_events") < 5)
    .select("operator", "session_id", "n_events", "duration_min")
    .orderBy(F.col("operator").desc(), "duration_min", "session_id")
    .limit(5)
)

WITH filtered_policys AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        holder_id,
        product,
        premium,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        status,
        QUARTER(start_date) AS start_date_quarter,
        QUARTER(end_date) AS end_date_quarter,
        DATE_FORMAT(end_date, 'MMM yyyy') AS end_date_label
    FROM policies
    WHERE holder_id >= 8
      AND premium <= 4678.8
),
line_level AS (
    -- One row per claim
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.holder_id,
        s.premium,
        s.start_date,
        s.status,
        s.start_date_quarter,
        s.end_date_quarter,
        c.id AS claim_id,
        c.status AS claim_status,
        c.approved_amount AS claim_approved_amount,
        c.claim_date
    FROM filtered_policys s
    LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.policy_id = s.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        holder_id,
        start_date,
        status,
        start_date_quarter,
        end_date_quarter,
        claim_id,
        claim_approved_amount,
        claim_date,
        ROUND(start_date_quarter / NULLIF(SUM(start_date_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(claim_date), holder_id), 0), 4) AS start_date_quarter_share_of_claim_date_year_hold,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_id ORDER BY claim_approved_amount DESC, id, claim_id) AS claim_approved_amount_dense_rank,
        NTH_VALUE(premium, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY claim_id ORDER BY claim_approved_amount DESC, id, claim_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_premium,
        ROUND(claim_approved_amount - AVG(claim_approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(claim_date), holder_id), 2) AS claim_approved_amount_vs_claim_date_year_holder_,
        LAG(claim_approved_amount) OVER w_claim_id_by_claim_approved_a AS prev_claim_approved_amount
    FROM line_level
    WINDOW w_claim_id_by_claim_approved_a AS (PARTITION BY claim_id ORDER BY claim_approved_amount DESC, id, claim_id)
),
status_stats AS (
    -- Avg start_date_quarter per status
    SELECT status, AVG(start_date_quarter) AS avg_start_date_quarter
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY status
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_start_date_quarter,
        ROUND(s.start_date_quarter - g.avg_start_date_quarter, 2) AS start_date_quarter_minus_avg
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN status_stats g ON g.status = s.status
    WHERE s.start_date_quarter > g.avg_start_date_quarter
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per holder_id
    SELECT
        id,
        holder_id,
        start_date,
        status,
        start_date_quarter,
        end_date_quarter,
        claim_id,
        claim_approved_amount,
        claim_date,
        start_date_quarter_share_of_claim_date_year_hold,
        claim_approved_amount_dense_rank,
        second_premium,
        claim_approved_amount_vs_claim_date_year_holder_,
        prev_claim_approved_amount,
        avg_start_date_quarter,
        start_date_quarter_minus_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY holder_id ORDER BY start_date, id, claim_id) AS recency_rank
        FROM vs_group
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        holder_id,
        start_date,
        status,
        start_date_quarter,
        end_date_quarter,
        claim_id,
        start_date_quarter_share_of_claim_date_year_hold,
        claim_approved_amount_dense_rank,
        second_premium,
        prev_claim_approved_amount,
        avg_start_date_quarter,
        start_date_quarter_minus_avg,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', start_date) AS start_date_year,
        CASE WHEN start_date_quarter >= 3 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN start_date_quarter >= 2 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS start_date_quarter_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', claim_date) AS claim_date_quarter
    FROM latest
    WHERE status = 'CANCELLED'
)
SELECT id, claim_id, metric_name, reading
FROM (
    SELECT id, claim_id, second_premium, start_date_quarter_minus_avg
    FROM annotated
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric_name IN (second_premium AS m_second_premium, start_date_quarter_minus_avg AS m_start_date_quarter_minus_avg)
) unp
ORDER BY id, claim_id, metric_name

        p.region AS holder_region_2,

qualified AS (

    -- Filter claims
    SELECT *
    FROM claims
),
joined_policy AS (
    -- Join policies
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.policy_id,
        s.adjuster_id,
        s.claim_date,
        s.claim_type,
        s.claimed_amount,
        s.reported_at,
        p.start_date AS policy_start_date,
        p.status AS policy_status,
        p.holder_id AS policy_holder_id
    FROM scoped_claims s
    JOIN policies p ON p.id = s.policy_id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_date,
        claim_type,
        policy_start_date,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY policy_status ORDER BY reported_at DESC, id) AS reported_at_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(claim_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id, policy_holder_id ORDER BY reported_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_claim_date,
        ROUND(AVG(claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_status, TO_DATE(reported_at) ORDER BY reported_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS claimed_amount_avg_2_prior,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY policy_status ORDER BY reported_at DESC), 3) AS reported_at_percent_rank,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_adjuster_id_policy_holder_id_2 AS reported_at_quartile,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(policy_start_date), adjuster_id) AS rows_in_policy_start_date_year_adjuster_id,
        LAG(claim_date) OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id, policy_holder_id ORDER BY reported_at, id) AS prev_claim_date,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id, policy_holder_id ORDER BY reported_at, id) AS reported_at_rank_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY policy_status, TO_DATE(reported_at) ORDER BY reported_at, id) AS rn,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id, policy_holder_id ORDER BY reported_at, id) AS reported_at_quintile,
        LAG(reported_at) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_status ORDER BY reported_at DESC, id) AS prev_reported_at,
        MAX(claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_status ORDER BY reported_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS claimed_amount_max_1_prior,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_policy_status_by_reported_at, 3) AS reported_at_percent_rank_2
    FROM joined_policy
    WINDOW w_adjuster_id_policy_holder_id_2 AS (PARTITION BY adjuster_id, policy_holder_id ORDER BY reported_at, id), w_policy_status_by_reported_at AS (PARTITION BY policy_status ORDER BY reported_at DESC, id)
),
with_windows_2 AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_type,
        policy_start_date,
        reported_at_rank,
        first_known_claim_date,
        claimed_amount_avg_2_prior,
        reported_at_quartile,
        rows_in_policy_start_date_year_adjuster_id,
        prev_claim_date,
        rn,
        prev_reported_at,
        claimed_amount_max_1_prior,
        reported_at_percent_rank_2,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY rn ORDER BY prev_claim_date, id) AS prev_claim_date_quartile,
        reported_at_percent_rank_2 - LAG(reported_at_percent_rank_2) OVER (ORDER BY first_known_claim_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS reported_at_percent_rank_2_change,
        ROUND(reported_at_rank_2 - AVG(reported_at_rank_2) OVER w_reported_at_quintile, 2) AS reported_at_rank_2_vs_reported_at_quintile_avg,
        SUM(reported_at_rank_2) OVER (PARTITION BY reported_at_quintile) AS reported_at_quintile_sum_reported_at_rank_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rn ORDER BY prev_claim_date) AS prev_claim_date_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(reported_at_rank) OVER (ORDER BY first_known_claim_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS reported_at_rank_avg_2
    FROM with_windows

),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE claim_type = 'fire') AS n_claim_type_fire
    FROM with_windows_2
    GROUP BY YEAR(prev_claim_date), reported_at_rank
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    prev_claim_date_year,
    reported_at_rank,
    n_claim_type_flood,
    prev_claim_date_quartile_claim_type_flood,
    distinct_ids,
    n_claim_type_fire
FROM summary
ORDER BY n_claim_type_fire

    FROM with_parent

        s.moved_at,
        s.operator,
        s.unit_price,
        st.id AS move_id,

        st.sku_id AS move_sku_id,
        st.unit_price AS move_unit_price,
        st.operator AS move_operator
    FROM recent_moves s
    LEFT JOIN stock_moves st ON st.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND st.sku_id <= 15
),
combined_details_move AS (

        s.unit_price,

        s.move_sku_id,

        s.sku_id,
        s.move_type,
        s.moved_at,
        s.unit_price,
        s.move_id,
        s.move_move_type,
        s.move_sku_id,

        sk.category AS sku_category,
        sk.weight_kg AS sku_weight_kg,

    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(st.qty) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.sku_id = s.move_sku_id) AS min_move_qty,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.sku_id = s.move_sku_id) AS move_count,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(st.unit_price), 2) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.sku_id = s.move_sku_id) AS avg_move_unit_price
    FROM combined_details s

        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM profiled

with_windows AS (

        MIN(move_count) OVER (PARTITION BY row_count, move_sku_id) AS row_count_move_sku_id_min_move_count,

)

    FROM with_windows
) src

WITH base_readings AS (
    -- Filter meter_readings
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality,
        GREATEST(voltage, kwh) AS greatest_voltage_kwh,
        CASE WHEN voltage >= 232.0 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN voltage >= 222.5 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS voltage_tier
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE (read_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-19 13:00:00' OR site_id <= 7)
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per site_id
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality,
        greatest_voltage_kwh,
        voltage_tier
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY greatest_voltage_kwh DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM base_readings
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, voltage_tier ORDER BY kwh), 3) AS kwh_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY voltage DESC, id) AS rn,
        SUM(greatest_voltage_kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id) AS site_id_sum_greatest_voltage_kwh,
        ROUND(AVG(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, voltage_tier ORDER BY kwh, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS kwh_avg_7,
        ROUND(AVG(voltage) OVER (ORDER BY voltage DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS voltage_avg_7,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_all_by_voltage_ties AS voltage_dense_rank
    FROM latest_per_key
    WINDOW w_all_by_voltage_ties AS (ORDER BY voltage DESC)
),
derived AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN voltage_tier IN ('HIGH', 'LOW') THEN 'group_a' WHEN voltage_tier = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS voltage_tier_group
    FROM metrics
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    site_id,
    kwh,
    voltage,
    quality,
    greatest_voltage_kwh,
    voltage_tier,
    rn,
    kwh_avg_7,
    voltage_avg_7,
    voltage_dense_rank,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(quality), ' ', '_')) AS quality_slug
FROM derived
ORDER BY quality_slug DESC, voltage_dense_rank DESC

WITH valid_readings AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality
    FROM meter_readings
),
quality_stats AS (
    -- Median voltage per quality
    SELECT quality, PERCENTILE_APPROX(voltage, 0.5) AS median_voltage
    FROM valid_readings
    GROUP BY quality
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_voltage,
        ROUND(s.voltage - g.median_voltage, 2) AS voltage_minus_median
    FROM valid_readings s
    JOIN quality_stats g ON g.quality = s.quality
    WHERE s.voltage >= g.median_voltage
),
totals AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        site_id,
        quality,
        SUM(CASE WHEN quality IN ('BAD', 'EST') THEN kwh ELSE 0 END) AS kwh_quality_in_bad_est,
        MIN(voltage_minus_median) AS min_voltage_minus_median,
        COUNT(DISTINCT quality) AS distinct_qualitys
    FROM above_average
    WHERE site_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY site_id, quality
    HAVING AVG(voltage_minus_median) > -49.0
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows that have matching meter_readings
    SELECT s.*
    FROM totals s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM meter_readings m
            WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id
              AND m.quality = 'BAD'
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT s.*, si.site_name, si.commissioned_on AS site_commissioned_on
    FROM screened s
    LEFT JOIN sites si ON si.id = s.site_id AND si.zone NOT IN ('Z3', 'Z2')
)
SELECT
    quality,
    site_id,
    GROUPING(quality) AS is_total_quality,
    ROUND(SUM(kwh_quality_in_bad_est), 2) AS total_kwh_quality_in_bad_est
FROM enriched

        NTH_VALUE(level, 2) OVER (ORDER BY level, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_level,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY level), 3) AS level_percent_rank,
        ROUND(level / NULLIF(SUM(level) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 0), 4) AS level_share_of_level,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY level, id) AS level_quartile,
        level - LAG(level) OVER w_level_by_level AS level_change,
        LAG(level, 1, 0) OVER w_all_by_level_2 AS prev_level,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY level) AS rows_in_level,
        ROUND(AVG(level) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 2) AS level_avg_level
    FROM recent_adjusters
    WINDOW w_level_by_level AS (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY level NULLS LAST, id), w_level AS (PARTITION BY level), w_all_by_level_2 AS (ORDER BY level DESC, id)
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,

        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY level_vs_level_avg ASC, id) AS level_vs_level_avg_dense_rank,
        ROUND(prev_level / NULLIF(SUM(prev_level) OVER w_second_level_team, 0), 4) AS prev_level_share_of_second_level_team,
        FIRST_VALUE(level_avg_level) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY team, prev_level ORDER BY second_level DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_level_avg_level,
        ROUND(rows_in_level - AVG(rows_in_level) OVER w_second_level_team, 2) AS rows_in_level_vs_second_level_team_avg,
        ROUND(second_level / NULLIF(SUM(second_level) OVER (PARTITION BY second_level, team), 0), 4) AS second_level_share_of_second_level_team,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_team_prev_level_by_second_le_2 AS seq_no
    FROM windowed
    WINDOW w_second_level_team AS (PARTITION BY second_level, team), w_team_prev_level_by_second_le_2 AS (PARTITION BY team, prev_level ORDER BY second_level DESC, id)
),
totals AS (

    SELECT
        level_vs_level_avg_rank,
        SUM(CASE WHEN team = 'Motor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_team_motor,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        SUM(first_known_level_avg_level) FILTER (WHERE team IS NOT NULL) AS first_known_level_avg_level_team_is_not_null
    FROM with_trends
    GROUP BY level_vs_level_avg_rank

        ROUND(voltage / NULLIF(SUM(voltage) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id), 0), 4) AS voltage_share_of_site_id,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id) AS rows_in_site_id
    FROM recent
    WINDOW w_site_id AS (PARTITION BY site_id)
),
site_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg voltage_share_of_site_id per site_id

    WHERE s.voltage_share_of_site_id > g.avg_voltage_share_of_site_id
